# Parsedown 1.8.0

Source: https://github.com/erusev/parsedown/releases/tag/1.8.0

License: MIT (see LICENSE.txt).

The source is bundled for offline Markdown rendering. The only upstream-source change is the `PackageManager\vendor\parsedown` namespace, which prevents collisions with parsers loaded by other packages. PackageReadme sanitizes rendered output before display.
